description: Deploy-as-API for workflows: deriving API inputs from a flattened workflow, building the coding-agent handoff prompt and bundle, and the Deploy to Comfy API dialog. The workflow store, workflow flattening, missing-model scanning, and the Comfy API configuration remain external.

characterizationScenarios.name: API inputs and agent handoff content are derived deterministically from the workflow
Deploy dialog copies or downloads the agent handoff for the active workflow

compatibilityPromises: The deploy-as-api action id stays stable for the workflow actions menu.
Unclassified callers may import deployment internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
The dialog launcher that loads presentation remains visible as role-boundary debt; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
